content: .{@-आधानम्@} .²1 impregnation; गर्भाधानक्षणपरिचयान्नूनमाबद्धमालाः (बलाकाः) <ls>Me. 9</ls>. .²2 one of the Saṃskāras or purificatory ceremonies performed after menstruation to ensure or facilitate conception; (this ceremony legalizes in a religious sense the {%consummation%} of marriage); <ls>Y. 1. 11</ls>.
